heading.en: Aaron teaches Lamoni's father about the Creation, the Fall of Adam, and the plan of redemption through Christ—The king and all his household are converted—The division of the land between the Nephites and the Lamanites is explained. About 90–77 B.C.
heading.sm: Ua a'oa'o e Arona le tamā o Lamonae e uiga i le Foafoaga, le Pa'ū o Atamu, ma le fuafuaga o le togiola e ala ia Keriso—Ua liua le tupu ma lona auaiga atoa—Ua faamatala mai le vaevaega o le laueleele i le va o sa Nifaē ma sa Lamanā. E tusa o le 90–77 T.L.M.
